comments.body:
Obtained from doing the 'Further Research Quests'. You got that immediately after getting the discovery of the quest you choose. So far, you get 1 per quest.

I haven't do much of it because how many the amount of Sophia needed for doing them. Out of three chests, i got 9x Headache Medication (3 per chest).
